about: The four-state matrix of the body of POST /access/v1/permissions/assign: role, level, mapping, and a mapping element's permission and pipNames, each absent, null, "", blank, with whitespace at its ends, in another JSON type or as a list of one, in a tenant of its own per case. Each case declares its domain, writes a simplified policy that permits READ when subject.permissions holds the assigned permission, decides, assigns, decides again and reads the role's permissions back at level custom. A reference case with every field as documented comes first and last.
